detail.title: Longitudinal Memory and Preference Anchoring
detail.question: To what extent can episodic memory recall act as an anchor for stable preferences in the absence of explicit objective functions?
detail.reason: Attention is focused on memory_formed_preferences; this project explores the mechanics by which accumulated experiences translate into stable decision heuristics.
